79712.subject: Have you generated your Recovery Kit?
79712.body:
Your Passkey lives on
your device. A Recovery Kit is your backup if you ever lose
access.

*****************************************************************
SECURE YOUR
WALLET.
*****************************************************************

Hi
Novosadov oleh,

There's one
quick thing that keeps your Socios.com account safe for the long
run: your Recovery Kit.

You already use your
Passkey, the Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN you created when
setting up your wallet to confirm all your wallet transactions
inside the app. To ensure you never lose access when switching or
upgrading devices, make sure cloud syncing is turned
on:

* iPhone: Turn on iCloud
Keychain in your Apple
settings.
* Android: Turn on Google
Password Manager in your Google
settings.
Your
Recovery Kit is the backstop for everything else. If you ever
lose access to your Passkey, it's the only way back into your
Wallet.

Generate
your Recovery Kit

We noticed you
haven't generated yours yet. Generating your Recovery Kit is the
only way to restore your Socios.com Wallet if you lose your
Passkey. Go to Account Management > Recovery Kit > Generate, then
store it somewhere safe.

Socios.com cannot
restore your Wallet or assets if both your Passkey and Recovery
Kit are lost.

Generate My
Kit  
( https://clicks.socios.com/f/a/8KhyKiWj_pKhq76aL0ZwQw~~/AAAHahA~/Ih2flQ22HAJuy33EQdJKs-RLnPyHYs-iSQhrxdPF1301j48PTieX66_F7lBj72vEgD0H8NgHxu6q6E9fEifdVItY8X7G707S2Qnl7NzSlByZVI6-HUhq0MHsyl6nXMQGYblFdbH4lCslxKg05MqPl_XzcSWV0kS22GA_ZtYiu0_dOHTE81yri45KZRPd4QUl )
  If you've already
generated your Recovery Kit, no action is needed. Just make sure
the Recovery Kit is safely
stored.

New to
Passkeys? Our guide 
( https://clicks.socios.com/f/a/VN0rdx0jlcic56MOmKbGIA~~/AAAHahA~/CRmPQazal04XawBE9uN3hSHQCdg5loa2lZphSTa6awt9HAdbXlUtaScxUH0zCygfC_5wy5e_S-on5-9jCoCG_FgrJLkvJaMR5gzu9YdWEzcCxq_j00SNFLhocl7HmgolJkoJxFT5jCRZ6Gr08hXzkqb5yx4UfHHlspPRXV_Ds2I~ )

Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic will now charge you when Claude refuses to answer, and it's as bad as it sounds. Meta wants you making games from a text prompt that your friends play inside Instagram. Twenty people can now share one AI-generated world with no game engine underneath. And JPMorgan thinks Muse could be the most used AI app since ChatGPT.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** Why are you paying for answers you didn't get?

* **Meta:** Can you really build a game from one sentence?

* **Odyssey:** What does a game look like with no game engine?

* **JPMorgan:** Why did it raise Meta's target by $100?


----------







----------
## Claude now charges you for saying no

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9a6ee94c-b814-4808-8d21-cfdb07af888c/Sep_25_-_1.jpg?t=1790327390)
Caption: 

Anthropic [will bill you for requests its safeguards block](https://x.com/claudedevs/status/2103170368794185758) before Claude writes a single word. You send the prompt, a classifier decides it doesn't like it, you get nothing back, and you pay the full input rate anyway.

Anthropic says it's a defense against coordinated attacks it's seen in recent weeks. It's hard to see how. The attackers are the 0.3% using stolen keys and cards. The bill lands on whoever owns the key.

For now it's three categories, biology, distillation attacks and frontier model development. Anthropic says the classifiers rarely get these wrong. Rarely isn't never, and it has said nothing about refunds when they do. The classifiers get these wrong with me at least twice a day, not sure about you.

* A blocked 10,000-token agent prompt on Fable 5.1 costs about 10 cents, every time it fires

* Use the fallback feature and you pay for the refusal and the retry

* Nobody has said how this hits a Pro or Max subscription

This was free since June. Anthropic sneakily took that back and called it "resuming."

The obvious move was banning the people attacking. Instead, everyone gets the bill. 


----------







----------
